items.text: Inkatho yesibili yadla uSimeyoni, isizwe sabantwana bakwaSimeyoni ngezizukulwane zabo; ifa labo laliphakathi kwefa labantwana bakwaJuda.
Efa labo babeneBeri Sheba noma iSheba neMolada;
noHasarsual, noBala, no-Asem,
ne-Elitoladi, neBethule, neHorma,
neZikilagi, neBeti-Marabhoti, neHazarsusa,
neBetlebawoti neSaruheni; imizi eyishumi nantathu nemizana yayo;
i-Ayini, iRemoni, ne-Etere, ne-Asan; imizi emine nemizana yayo.
Nayo yonke imizi eyayizungeza leyo mizi kwaze kwaba seBahalati Beyeri, iRama laseNingizimu. Leli yifa lesizwe sabantwana bakwaSimeyoni ngezizukulwane zabo.
Ifa labantwana bakwaSimeyoni lalivela efeni labantwana bakwaJuda; ngokuba isabelo sabantwana bakwaJuda sasisikhulu kakhulu kubo; ngalokho abantwana bakwaSimeyoni bathola ifa labo efeni labo.
Inkatho yesithathu yaphumela abantwana bakwaZebuloni ngemindeni yabo, umkhawulo wefa labo wawufinyelela eSaridi.
Umkhawulo wabo wenyukela elwandle naseMarala, wenyuka waya eDabaseti nasemfuleni ongaphambi kweJokineyamu;
waphenduka eSaridi ngasempumalanga, ngasekuphumeni kwelanga, waya emngceleni weKisilothabori, waphuma waya eDaberati, wenyukela eJafiya;
Wasuka lapho, waya ngasempumalanga eGitha Heferi, waze wafika e-Ittakasin, waphuma waya eRimoni-methowari eNeyagi;
Umkhawulo wawuzungeza ohlangothini lwasenyakatho kwaze kwaba seHanatoni, ukuphuma kwawo kwakusesigodini saseJeftaheli.
NeKatati, neNahalali, neShimroni, ne-Idala, neBetlehema: imizi eyishumi nambili nemizana yayo.
Leli laliyifa labantwana bakwaZebuloni ngemindeni yabo, leyo mizi nemizana yayo.
Inkatho yesine yadla u-Isakare, abantwana bakwa-Isakare ngezizukulwane zabo.
Umkhawulo wabo wawuseJizreyeli, neKesuloti, neShunemi;
namaHafari, neSiyoni, ne-Anaharati,
neRabiti, neKisioni, no-Abesi,
neRemethe, ne-Eni Ganimi, ne-Eni-Hada, neBeti Pass;
Umkhawulo usuka eThabori, naseSahasima, naseBeti Shemeshi; ukuphuma komkhawulo wabo kwaseJordani: imizi eyishumi nesithupha nemizana yayo.
Leli yifa lesizwe sabantwana bakwa-Isakare ngemindeni yabo, imizi nemizana yayo.
Inkatho yesihlanu yadla isizwe sabantwana bakwa-Asheri ngemindeni yabo.
Umkhawulo wabo wawuyiHelikati, neHali, neBeteni, ne-Agisafa,
ne-Alamelegi, ne-Amadi, neMishali; wafinyelela eKarmeli ngasentshonalanga naseSihori-libinati;
Waphendukela ngasempumalanga ngaseBeti Dagoni, wafika kwaZebuloni nasesigodini saseJeftayeli ngasenyakatho kwaseBeti Temeki naseNeyiyeli, waphuma waya eKabuli ngakwesokhohlo;
neHebroni, neRehobe, neHamoni, neKhana, kuze kube seSidoni elikhulu;
Khona-ke umngcele osogwini wajika waya eRama nasedolobheni eliqinile laseTire; umkhawulo osogwini wajika waya eHosa; futhi ukuphuma kwawo kungasolwandle kusukela ogwini kuze kufike e-Agisibi.
NeUma, ne-Afeki, neRehobe: imizi engamashumi amabili nambili nemizana yayo.
Leli laliyifa lesizwe soonyana baka-Asheri ngemindeni yabo, leyo mizi nemizana yayo.
Inkatho yesithupha yadla abantwana bakwaNafetali, abantwana bakwaNafetali ngezizukulwane zabo.
Umkhawulo wabo wasukela eHelefi, e-Aloni, waya eSaananimi, nase-Adami, naseNekebi, naseJabineyeli, waya eLakumi; ukuphuma kwawo kwakungaseJordani;

Umkhawulo wajika ngasentshonalanga e-Ashinoti-Thabori, waphuma lapho, waya eHukoki, wagijima waya kwaZebuloni ngaseningizimu, wafinyelela kwa-Asheri ngasentshonalanga, nakwaJuda ngaseJordani ngasempumalanga.
Imizi ebiyelweyo yayiyiSidimi, neSere, neHamati, neRakati, neKinereti,
ne-Adamu, neRama, neHasori,
neKedeshi, ne-Edreyi, ne-Enihasori,
no-Ister, neMigidaleli, neHoremu, neBetanati, neBeti Shemeshi; imizi eyishumi nesishiyagalolunye nemizana yayo.
Leli laliyifa lesizwe sabantwana bakwaNafetali ngemindeni yabo, imizi nemizana yayo.
Inkatho yesikhombisa yadla isizwe sabantwana bakwaDani ngezizukulwane zabo.
Umkhawulo wefa labo wawuyiZora, ne-Eshitawoli, ne-Irsememi;
noShaalabhibini, no-Ajaloni, noJetla,
ne-Eloni, neThimnati, ne-Ekroni,
ne-Eliteke, neGibethoni, neBhahalati,
noJehudi, noBene Beraki, neGati-rimoni,
neMejarikoni, neRakoni, nomngcele ophambi kweYafo.

Umkhawulo wabantwana bakwaDani waba mncane kakhulu kubo; ngakho-ke abantwana bakwaDani bakhuphuka ukuze balwe neLesemi futhi balithatha futhi balinqoba ngosiko lwenkemba futhi balithatha futhi bahlala kulo futhi balibiza iLeshimu ngokuthi Dani ngegama likayise uDani.
Leli yifa lesizwe sabantwana bakwaDani ngezizukulwane zabo, lezi zakhamuzi nemizana yazo.
Lapho sebeqedile ukwaba izwe libe yifa ngokwemingcele yabo, abantwana bakwa-Israyeli bamnika uJoshuwa indodana kaNuni ifa phakathi kwabo.
Njengezwi likaJehova bamnika umuzi awucelayo, iThimnati-Sera ezintabeni zakwa-Efrayimi; wakha umuzi, wahlala kuwo.

Lawa angamafa u-Eleyazare umpristi, noJoshuwa, indodana kaNuni, nezinhloko zezindlu zoyise zezizwe zabantwana bakwa-Israyeli, ngenkatho eShilo phambi kukaJehova ngasemnyango wetabernakele, njengalokho behlukaniselwa izwe. Ifa elivela ebandleni. Base beqeda ukuhlukanisa izwe.
